Landscaping & drainage in Walker

Just up I-12 from Denham Springs, Walker is larger-lot Livingston Parish - more room between houses, more yard to manage, and the same low, flat ground that holds water. That combination makes grading, drainage and large-property mowing the work we do most here.

What we do here

Full-property care for Walker homes

On a bigger Walker lot, water has room to move but often nowhere to go. Low back corners stay soggy for days, and mowing a large, uneven yard is a chore. We re-establish fall across the property and tie the low spots into drainage so the whole yard drains and mows clean.

Walker also flooded in 2016, so homeowners here take standing water seriously. Whether it is regrading a settled area, burying downspouts or setting up recurring maintenance on a larger property, being based one exit away means we are close.

Common problems

What we solve most in Walker

Large, uneven lots

Bigger Walker yards settle unevenly. We regrade so the surface is smooth, mowable and drains.

Slow-draining ground

Flat Livingston Parish clay holds water. We add drainage that carries it to a real outlet.

Big-property mowing

Large lots need the right equipment on a set schedule. We handle full-property maintenance.

Walker questions

Walker FAQs

Do you mow larger properties in Walker?
Yes. Large-property and acreage mowing is common here. We set a schedule with the right equipment and can add bed care and seasonal work to the same agreement.
My back yard stays soggy for days - can you fix it?
That is a grading and drainage issue, which we handle a lot in Walker. We re-establish fall and run drainage to a suitable outlet so water leaves instead of sitting. It starts with a free site visit.
How close are you to Walker?
We are based one exit west in Denham Springs, so Walker gets fast, same-day response.
What grass grows best in Walker yards?
Most Walker-area lawns are St. Augustine or centipede, with zoysia on sunnier lots. We match turf and plant material to your light, your soil and how the space is used, and leave after-care instructions so it establishes.
Do you charge for an estimate in Walker?
No. Estimates are free with no trip fee and no diagnostic fee. Send a few photos or have us out, and you get a written price with a clearly defined scope, usually the same day.
What other areas near Walker do you serve?
Plenty. Along with Walker we regularly work Denham Springs, Livingston, Watson and Central and much of Greater Baton Rouge and surrounding areas. If you are not sure we reach you, send your address and we will confirm coverage.
